sentences.en: Though once cloaked in the trappings of the occult, conversations with local psychics suggest a slightly more psychotherapeutic approach.

sentences.en: Let me turn now to a consideration of some psychotherapeutic as well as religious efforts to assuage existence anxiety. Consider first the ultimate concern of meaninglessness .

sentences.en: As a methodology, post - structuralism has affected many disciplines in social science. So was the psychotherapeutic practice.
